paper_title: Probing a diffuse flux of axion-like particles from galactic supernovae with neutrino water Cherenkov detectors
coupling_convention: g_ap, dimensionless ALP-proton coupling, as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper derives new observed exclusion from Super-Kamiokande (phases I-IV) data on a diffuse galactic supernova ALP flux detected via a p -> p gamma. The excluded region is a BAND in g_ap: approximately 2e-5 < g_ap < 2e-4 for ALP masses 1-70 MeV (couplings above ~2e-4 are not excluded because ALPs are trapped in the proto-NS and never reach Earth). Data points give the lower edge of the excluded band as a flat line over the stated mass range 1-70 MeV; no numerical table is provided, values taken from abstract/text describing Fig. 4. A separate Hyper-Kamiokande projection reaching g_ap ~ 1e-5 (for ma <= 50 MeV) is also presented but the primary result is the observed SK limit. Not a dark-matter haloscope, so no local DM density assumed.
